description: Codex: Orks (11e) MOW 'EM DOWN (War Horde) through the real unit_selected_to_fight window on the Orks' own turn. Fixture ork11e_orks_active: P1 Orks active. Setup-only privileges (during the Orks' Charge phase): the Battlewagon is marked as having made a charge move (charged_this_turn + Fights First, what a successful charge sets) and Custodian Guard C is placed in front of it (5 models, engaged); the Custodians' wounds are inflated so the unit survives; auto wound allocation for the Custodes defender. The Ork player clicks the Battlewagon in the fighter picker; the window shows HIT 'EM HARDER and MOW 'EM DOWN with enabled Use buttons; a real click on MOW 'EM DOWN spends 1 CP and gives the Battlewagon's melee attacks [CLEAVE 1] / +1 [CLEAVE]. The fight is resolved through the attack dialog + resolution dock: every melee hit roll against the 5-model unit has exactly (A + new CLEAVE value) dice — Crushin' Bulk [CLEAVE 2] rolls A+3, a weapon without [CLEAVE] rolls A+1.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Battlewagon charged (flags a successful charge move sets) and is engaged with Custodian Guard C

steps.equals: Battlewagon has been selected to fight

steps.comment: every melee hit roll vs the 5-model unit: A + the new [CLEAVE] value dice
